SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.PROJNO, C.ORDERNO, C.LABELNO, C.ORDERCATEGORY, C.ACCEPTEDDATE, D.TESTNAME, D.SAMPLERECEIVERFLAG, D.TESTMETHODID, D.MONITORTMPLID, E.EXTRACTMETHOD, G.ORDERCONTAINERNO FROM T_EMC_PRETREATMENT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER C ON A.ORDERID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK D ON A.ORDERTASKID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EXTRACT_METHOD E ON A.EXTRACTMETHODID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PURIFY_METHOD F ON A.PURIFYMETHODID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER G ON D.ORDERCONTAINERID = G.ID) T
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.TESTMETHODID = T.TESTMETHODID AND OT.MONITORTMPLID = T.MONITORTMPLID AND OT.ID IN
#{item}
)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
